english.note: Old-scale sections: reading/listening/speaking 19, writing 22. New-scale: reading/speaking 4, listening/writing 4.5. IELTS sections at least 6.0. Automatic waivers include qualifying completed U.S./English-speaking-country bachelor's and U.S.-campus AAU master's degrees; other waiver requests go through department.

documents: Personal statement: motivation and professional goals
Research statement: previous work, interests and fit with intended laboratory
requirements.note: Contact prospective faculty before applying; sponsorship important. Suggested preparation: calculus plus additional calculus/statistics, organic chemistry plus additional organic/biochemistry, one semester physics. Missing suggested courses need not prevent application. Graduate School offers McNair and targeted recruitment-event waivers; international eligibility not explicitly stated, confirm. FreeApp participation ends December 31, 2026. Fee amount not established on opened pages.

funding.note: Doctoral students guaranteed five years of support through teaching/research assistantships; support covers living expenses and tuition. Discuss research costs and funding with faculty.
